1
Hai Ashkon Se Tar Chehra Har Hashmi Ka.
Kiye Bain Roti Hain Qayam Ki Madar.
Ajab Haal Gham Se Hai Bint-e-Nabi Ka.
Issi Ne Hi Mara Tha Mohsin Ko Logon.
Saqeefa Ne Mara Hai Beta Naqi Ka.
Do Pursa Yateemi Ka Mehdi Sakhi Ko.
Keh Yeh Farz Bachta Hai Har Matami Ka.
 Nisar, Askari Ka Na Gar Gham Ho Iss Mein.
Tu Maqsad Nahi Hai Koi Zindagi Ka.

item.text:
Reconstructed all nine verses in Urdu script and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`, preserving the wording and verse order. Verified that both editions contain one stanza of nine verses. Updated the title and direction and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read `Qayam` as قائم, the title for Mehdi, and `logon` as the direct address لوگو.
